title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Screens in U.S., Canada on January 29
content: Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film on January 29, 2027 in the U.S. and Canada. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Movie Hits Theaters Worldwide in January 2027, in North America on January 29
content: Witch on the Holy Night anime movie will begin its worldwide theatrical release in January 2027, with Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment announcing release dates for multiple international markets. It will premiere in Japan on November 20, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Korean Culture Center to Host K-Comics Origin Exhibition in Los Angeles
content: The Korean Culture Center Los Angeles, in collaboration with the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA), will host the 2026 K-Comics Origin Los Angeles – Korean Webtoon Experience Exhibition from September 11 to October 17.
author: ANN

title: Web Novel, Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series The Ordinary Jackpot Debuts on September 10
content: The Ordinary Jackpot , the live-action series based on the web novel and webtoon of the same name, will premiere on the Korean streaming platform TVING on September 10, with its first two episodes released exclusively on the service.
author: ANN

title: Pokémon Pokopia Game Introduces Accessories Included in Expansion Pass DLC Part 2
content: Nintendo introduced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday the additional new features of the paid Expansion Pass DLC part 2 of Pokémon Pokopia , its cozy-style life simulation crafting game for the Pokémon franchise . The DLC part 2 includes accessories such as sunglasses, Sylveon ribbon, and bow tie.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Special Episode 63 Ending Featuring "friend" by Kyoko and Haru
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its special Episode 63 ending, featuring the song “friend” performed by Kyoko’s and Haru’s voice actresses, Yuna Inamura and Hitomi Yoshida. The original song by IDOLING!!!
author: Anime Corner

title: Nintendo Reveals New Trailer, October 22 Launch for Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Game
content: Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that Nintendo Switch Sports Resort , the successor game to Wii Sports Resort , will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 22. The company also revealed a new trailer for the game.
author: ANN

title: Mega Man Dual Override Game Announces Spring 2027 Launch
content: Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that Mega Man: Dual Override , a new game in its Mega Man series, will launch in spring 2027. The game will launch for the Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Eat-Man' Gets New Anime Adaptation
content: Entertainment company Hakuhodo DY Music & Pictures opened an official website for a new anime adaptation of Akihito Yoshitomi 's Eat-Man manga, subtitled The Over Order , on Thursday, revealing the lead cast, main staff, teaser visual, and announcement promotional video.
